TileStructure.Forest.density_tree_bound2.issue: the English writes 'supp f ⊆ F' / 'supp g ⊆ G', which readers take as the closed support, while the Lean hypothesis is Function.support (the set where the function is nonzero) contained in the set; this makes the hypothesis stronger unless stated as {x : f(x) ≠ 0} ⊆ F
